component.name: FinTer
component.summary: Native market terminal for live crypto and financial charts

description.p: FinTer is a native desktop market terminal for people who read charts for a living. It combines live crypto market data, a real charting engine, and a persistent workspace in a single fast application.

ul.li: Live OHLCV candlestick and Heikin Ashi charts with indicators.
Order books, trade tape, tickers, watchlists, and market news.
Resizable pane layouts that persist between sessions.
Local-first guest mode with optional cloud sync.

screenshot.caption: Live charting, market panels, and watchlists
